basic_info.description: Wonderful location in Lakeshore, just moments away from Lakeshore Elementary and Lowell High   School. Lots of natural light throughout, offering a living room with fireplace and parquet hardwood   floors, formal dining room, and a breakfast nook in the kitchen. 3 spacious bedrooms and a full bath complete the main level.  This home needs lots of TLC, and boasts endless possibilities of   additional square footage downstairs with 2 extra rooms and a 1/2 bath, all with high ceilings.  This is a partial probate   sale, no court confirmation necessary, but we will need two days response time for offers.  Incredible opportunity to make this a wonderful large home in a highly desirable neighborhood.
